items.html: Also, after the Yesod of Atik, with the Hesed within it, clothed in the forehead of AA, as above, and from there they returned to shine and spread in the beard, in the Mazal, which is the thirteenth correction, and also in the correction called "keeping mercy," as mentioned. And it is mentioned in [the portion of] Haazinu, page 289, side A: "and this desire spread downward in the beard," etc. And also the beard itself is in the secret of Yesod; therefore women, who have no aspect of Yesod, have no beard. And also the Hod in it was revealed in the beard, as written in the Idra of Naso, page 140, side B: "and it is taught, the supernal Hod came out, and was crowned and flowed to unite in its height, and is called the Hod of the beard."
